brief:
The Hebron Northern Chamber of Commerce and Industry will host its inaugural Palestinian Investment Conference on Thursday, according to Maan Wire. The event marks the first such gathering organized by the chamber, which covers trade, industry, and agriculture sectors in the region.

The conference aims to bring together investors and stakeholders to explore economic opportunities in northern Hebron and support local business development initiatives.
title: Palestinian Chamber of Commerce launches first investment conference in northern Hebron
